# Stiamond

> AI, Software & Cloud Engineering Company

Stiamond designs AI-powered software, cloud infrastructure, and digital growth systems that accelerate business performance.

## Expertise

- AI Engineering: LLM integration, RAG systems, AI agents, intelligent automation
- Software Engineering: Custom software, web platforms, SaaS products
- Cloud Infrastructure: Scalable architecture, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code
- Growth Systems: SEO, content strategy, marketing automation, data-driven growth
- Automation: Workflow orchestration, process optimization, intelligent pipelines

## Products

- MEDIM: AI-powered medical intelligence platform
- AI Platform: Multi-model AI gateway with intelligent routing (Gemini, Groq, Ollama, OpenAI)
- APIs: Developer-first APIs for AI, data, and infrastructure
- Developer SDK: Tools for building with Stiamond's platform
- Marketplace: Integration marketplace for Stiamond ecosystem

## Services

- AI Engineering: Chatbots, RAG, AI agents, LLM integration
- Software Engineering: Web apps, SaaS, APIs, microservices
- Cloud: Architecture, DevOps, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes
- Automation: Process automation, workflow orchestration
- Growth: SEO/GEO, content, marketing automation, analytics
- Consulting: Technical strategy, architecture review, team training

## Industries

- Healthcare
- Retail
- Finance
- Education
- Logistics
- Professional Services
